title: a resource's usage text from its author
description: The author's own words about using a resource, per upstream version: model description and version notes with HTML stripped, and the usage lines (weight, CFG, steps, sampler) extracted from them. `standards build` reads it as the `author` source. Raw HTML, creator names and image lists are never stored.

schema.description: the format and its version; always the first key

legacy_id.description: records imported from another store keep their original id in legacy_id; null for records made here. It lets an imported record be traced back and is never shown in public text

sha16.description: a resource id: the first 16 hex digits of the file's sha256

ts.description: ISO 8601 time, for example 2030-01-01T00:00:00+00:00; easel always writes the T and the UTC offset.
